'''Twi'leki''',<ref name="The Star Wars Sourcebook">''[[The Star Wars Sourcebook]]'' at 81</ref> '''Rylothean''',<ref name="GATORW">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref> or '''Ryl'''<ref name="Ultimate Alien Anthology">''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]'' at 172</ref> was the native spoken language of the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'leks]].

==History==
In addition to Ryl, Twi'leks were also fluent in '''Lekku language''', a silent form of communication using gestures made purely with the lekku. Only Twi'leks could express themselves this way, and few other [[Species/Legends|species]] could understand them readily. Lekku was ideal for private conversation between Twi'leks in crowded areas. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]] was one of the few non-Twi'leks to fully master Lekku.

[[Protocol droid/Legends|Protocol droids]] were unable to replicate the nuance of the lekku tics used in Twi'leki.<ref name="EGTD" />

Twi'leks were usually trilingual (in Ryl, Lekku and [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]]) and biliterate (in Ryl and Basic - Lekku had no written form). Many Twi'leks also learned to speak [[Huttese/Legends|Huttese]].

As of the [[Jedi Civil War]], an older form of the language, known simply as '''Twi'lek''', was the dominant interstellar commerce language outside of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]. It was claimed to be nearly as widespread as Basic.

==Words used as masculine given names==
The following words had a meaning in Ryl, but could be used as given names for male Twi'leks.<ref name="GCG">''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]''</ref>
*''Alask'' – desert, sand
*''Anoon'' – commander, warrior chief
*''Boc'' – stalagmite, rock column
*''Bril'' – wind
*''Byt'' – hammer (as a weapon)
*''Cazne'' – fortress, castle
*''Chee'' – war, warrior
*''Chom'' – drum
*''Cotan'' - tower
*''Darap'' – stone
*''Dinek'' – male ruler, king
*''Elav'' – scholar
*''Firith'' – defender
*''Glie'' - axe
*''Guzerre'' – priest, holy person
*''Haly'' – visitor
*''Hid'' – cliff
*''Ilar'' – ash, dust
*''Jela'' – sword
*''Jer'' – arrow
*''Karawn'' – strength
*''Kopecz'' – philosopher
*''Lonay'' – miner
*''Nabat'' – farm, farmer
*''Nat'' – rock
*''Nawara'' – speaker, tongue
*''Nerra'' – brother
*''Nuro'' – judge
*''Olm'' – porter, bearer
*''Pol'' – stalactite
*''Ree'' – spear
*''Reess'' – metalsmith
*''Rol'' – sun
*''Silais'' – gatekeeper, caretaker
*''Siolo'' - poet
*''Skawn'' – merchant
*''Tal'' – champion
*''Tol'' – fire
*''Tott'' – thorn bush, fang
*''Valsil'' – tailor
*''Vuren'' – mountain
*''Warat'' – victor, winner
*''Yuned'' – thunder
*''Zelada'' – traveler, explorer

==Other words==
*''[[Nawara Ven|Nawar'aven]]'' – silver tongued
*''Nawara'ven'' - tarnished silver
*''Nerra'' – brother {{Audio|NerraMeansBrother-IoR.flac|Listen}}
*''tchun-tchin'' - alternate name for [[lekku]]
**''tchin'' - right lek
**''tchun'' - left lek
*''Wedgan'tilles'' – Not actually a word in Ryl, but sounds similar to "slayer of stars". [[Tal'dira]] insisted on calling [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] this in favor of the [[Galactic Basic Standard|Basic]] pronunciation of his name, on the grounds that the latter loosely translated to "one so foul as to induce vomiting in a [[rancor]]".<ref name="Krytos">''[[X-Wing: The Krytos Trap]]''</ref>
